verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document strict typing or build-time schema validation that would let a coding agent catch its own mistakes before running. The closest items are adjacent rather than the capability itself: tool metadata that helps the LLM, ToolCallingAgent's structured JSON calls, and final_answer_checks, which are runtime validation functions run before accepting an answer.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on strict typing and schema validation so a coding agent catches its own mistakes at build time
